digest: Intrinsic programs shape brain maturation; however, which of these programs are perturbed by prematurity as well as the molecular pathways involved remain unknown.

Cerebellar growth and functional outcomes scaled with gestational age, despite modifying perinatal exposures.

d780b3b2fe15fd16.title: Two incoming lawmakers plan to defend health equity from Trump administration cuts
digest: Amid a sweep of Democratic victories in Tuesday’s midterms, some online commentators jokingly declared “Woke is back.”

There was little congressional pushback over the past two years as the Trump administration terminated hundreds of grants meant to chronicle and remedy medical inequities, shuttered programs intended to diversify the science workforce, and opened investigations into universities and medical schools it accused of discriminating against white and Asian applicants.
Will that change now that the Democratic Party has won control of the 120th Congress?
